name: The Gap Theory
overview: The Gap Theory proposes a temporal gap between Genesis 1:1 and 1:2, where God initially created the heavens and the earth, and the earth later became formless and void. Scripture affirms that God created all things in six days (Exodus 20:11) and declared His creation very good (Genesis 1:31), emphasizing His purposeful design. Isaiah 45:18 reinforces that God formed the earth not in vain but to be inhabited, highlighting the intentionality behind creation. This perspective seeks to harmonize the biblical account of creation with observations of the earth's condition described in Genesis 1:2.
